text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 18, 2024) for 90 Heath Street West.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 18, 2024) for 90 Heath Street West, Folder Number 24 230190 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to June 13, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
